## Before you hire

- Verify the plumber's Texas license through the [Texas State Board of Plumbing Examiners](https://tsbpe.texas.gov/)\.
- Request a written estimate and ask about diagnostic fees, emergency surcharges, and warranties.
- For expensive sewer or slab-leak work, get a second opinion before approving the repair.
